1use super::*;
2
3impl CacheManager {
4    pub(super) fn prune(&self, request: &CachePruneRequest) -> Result<CachePruneReport> {
5        let plan = CachePrunePlan::try_from(request)?;
6        let (entries, _) = self.inspect_all()?;
7        let total_bytes_before = entries.iter().fold(0u64, |total, cache| {
8            total.saturating_add(cache.entry.size_bytes)
9        });
10        let selected = select_prune_candidates(&entries, &plan, total_bytes_before);
11        let mut reclaimed_bytes = 0u64;
12        let mut results = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
13
14        for cache in entries {
15            let Some(mut reasons) = selected.get(&cache.entry.id).cloned() else {
16                results.push(prune_result(&cache, CachePruneOutcome::Kept, Vec::new()));
17                continue;
18            };
19            if cache.entry.active {
20                results.push(prune_result(
21                    &cache,
22                    CachePruneOutcome::skipped_active(),
23                    reasons,
24                ));
25                continue;
26            }
27            if !cache.safe_to_prune {
28                results.push(prune_result(
29                    &cache,
30                    CachePruneOutcome::skipped_unsafe(cache.entry.detail.clone()),
31                    reasons,
32                ));
33                continue;
34            }
35            if plan.execution.is_dry_run() {
36                reclaimed_bytes = reclaimed_bytes.saturating_add(cache.entry.size_bytes);
37                results.push(prune_result(
38                    &cache,
39                    CachePruneOutcome::WouldDelete,
40                    reasons,
41                ));
42                continue;
43            }
44
45            let database = cache.entry.path.join(DATABASE_NAME);
46            let coordination = IndexCoordination::for_database(&database);
47            let _lease = match coordination.try_acquire_prune_lease() {
48                Ok(Some(lease)) => lease,
49                Ok(None) => {
50                    reasons.push("prune_lease_unavailable".into());
51                    results.push(prune_result(
52                        &cache,
53                        CachePruneOutcome::skipped_active(),
54                        reasons,
55                    ));
56                    continue;
57                }
58                Err(error) => {
59                    results.push(prune_result(
60                        &cache,
61                        CachePruneOutcome::Failed {
62                            error: error.to_string(),
63                        },
64                        reasons,
65                    ));
66                    continue;
67                }
68            };
69            let current =
70                match self.inspect_managed_cache(&cache.entry.id, cache.identity.clone(), false) {
71                    Ok(current) => current,
72                    Err(error) => {
73                        results.push(prune_result(
74                            &cache,
75                            CachePruneOutcome::Failed {
76                                error: error.to_string(),
77                            },
78                            reasons,
79                        ));
80                        continue;
81                    }
82                };
83            let selected_for_compatibility = reasons
84                .iter()
85                .any(|reason| reason.starts_with("incompatible_with_current:"));
86            if selected_for_compatibility && !current.compatibility.safely_incompatible() {
87                reasons.retain(|reason| !reason.starts_with("incompatible_with_current:"));
88                if reasons.is_empty() {
89                    reasons.push(format!(
90                        "incompatible_with_current_revalidated:{}",
91                        current.compatibility.label()
92                    ));
93                    results.push(prune_result(&current, CachePruneOutcome::Kept, reasons));
94                    continue;
95                }
96            }
97            if !current.safe_to_prune {
98                results.push(prune_result(
99                    &current,
100                    CachePruneOutcome::skipped_unsafe(current.entry.detail.clone()),
101                    reasons,
102                ));
103                continue;
104            }
105            if reasons.len() == 1
106                && reasons[0] == "missing_repository"
107                && current.entry.repository_available != Some(false)
108            {
109                results.push(prune_result(&current, CachePruneOutcome::Kept, reasons));
110                continue;
111            }
112
113            let removal = remove_managed_artifacts(&current.entry.path);
114            reclaimed_bytes = reclaimed_bytes.saturating_add(removal.reclaimed_bytes);
115            match removal.error {
116                None => {
117                    results.push(prune_result(&current, CachePruneOutcome::Deleted, reasons));
118                }
119                Some(error) => results.push(prune_result(
120                    &current,
121                    CachePruneOutcome::Failed { error },
122                    reasons,
123                )),
124            }
125        }
126
127        results.sort_by(|left, right| left.id.cmp(&right.id));
128        Ok(CachePruneReport {
129            cache_root: self.root.clone(),
130            dry_run: plan.execution.is_dry_run(),
131            total_bytes_before,
132            total_bytes_after: total_bytes_before.saturating_sub(reclaimed_bytes),
133            reclaimed_bytes,
134            results,
135        })
136    }
137}
